author: Cabanis, 1873
status: 나그네새·겨울철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 한 해 내내 또는 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)

months.note: 산란기는 5월 상순~6월 상순이며, 국내 번식은 원문에 없다.

summary: 전국에 적은 수가 찾아와 겨울을 나는 드문 겨울철새이다. 주로 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 지내며, 작은 설치류, 개구리 같은 양서류, 파충류, 딱정벌레, 나비목 애벌레, 거미를 즐겨 잡아먹는다. 둥지는 나뭇가지 위에 마른 가지와 풀로 밥그릇 모양으로 짓고, 5월 상순~6월 상순에 한배에 알 6~9개를 낳는다. 중국 중부·남부와 한국 전역에 분포한다.

points.en: broad black eye-stripe below the eye
white throat, breast, underparts and rump

art.subject: Chinese Grey Shrike (Lanius sphenocercus), adult (sexes similar), as seen in open Korean farmland in winter: crown, nape, mantle and scapulars pale ash-grey; pale forehead and a white supercilium; broad black mask from the bill base through the eye to the ear coverts; rump paler, whitish-grey; wings black with a large white patch at the base of the primaries and white tips to the secondaries and tertials; tail long, the centre black and the outer feathers broadly white; throat and underparts white. Bill black, heavy and hooked; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: perched upright on a treetop, scanning the ground for prey
art.scene: open Korean farmland in winter with scattered bare trees, reed-lined ditches and dry stubble fields; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright: pale grey crown and back, white supercilium, broad black mask, white throat and underparts, black wings with a broad white bar at the primary bases, long black tail with white outer feathers, black bill and legs
adult in flight, seen from above: grey back, whitish rump, black wings with large white primary patches and white-tipped secondaries, long wedge-shaped tail with white sides
adult, head detail in side view: white supercilium above the broad black mask, heavy black hooked bill
art.build: The largest shrike in Korea, 31cm, approaching the length of an Azure-winged Magpie, bulky with a large head. Bill black, deep and strongly hooked. Legs black, fairly short. Tail very long and graduated (wedge-shaped). Perches upright on treetops and wires, scanning the ground. In flight broad white wing patches flash on black wings and the long tail shows white sides.
avoid: Do not paint a short tail; it is very long and wedge-shaped.
Do not omit the large white wing patch; on the perched bird it shows as a broad white bar across the black wing.
Do not paint brown or rufous tones (Brown Shrike, Long-tailed Shrike).
Do not paint a pink or pale bill; it is black.
